# Spot Screensaver

> A screensaver starring Spot, a black labrador with a red collar: he dozes in his blanket by a cabin fire, dreams (paws twitching, lips puffing), chases a butterfly, a tennis ball or a red laser dot through a golden meadow in his dream, then wakes up and dozes off again. In 3D (three.js, an AI-generated 3D model of the real dog) or in vector (SVG traced from his portrait). Runs as a macOS .saver and in any browser from one self-contained index.html. MIT licence for the code.

- URL options: style=3d|vector|alternate, quality=low|medium|high, scene=nap|dream|chase|wake, speed, seed, fps, sound=1.
- No network requests; nothing is uploaded or stored besides the chosen style and quality in localStorage.
